G2301.b:
*† ⟪θεατρίζω⟫

G2302.b:

(< θεάομαι),
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a theatre⟫ (used also as a place of assembly): ⟦Acts 19:29|Ac 19:29⟧, ⟦Acts 19:31|31⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Collective for οἱ θεαταί, the ⟪spectators⟫.
⟪3.⟫ = θέα, θέαμα, ⟪a spectacle⟫, ⟪show⟫: metaph., ⟦1 Corinthians 4:9|I Co 4:9⟧.†

G2304.b:
⟪θεῖος⟫, -εία, -εῖον
(< θεός), [in LXX: ⟦Exodus 31:3|Ex 31:3⟧ ⟦Exodus 35:31|35:31⟧, ⟦Job 27:3|Jb 27:3⟧ ⟦Job 33:4|33:4⟧, ⟦Proverbs 2:17|Pr 2:17⟧ (⁨אֵל⁩, ⁨אֱלוֹהַּ⁩, ⁨אֱלֹהִים⁩), Si 6:35, II Ma3, III Mac1, IV Mac25*;] ⟪divine⟫: δύναμις, ⟦2 Peter 1:3|II Pe 1:3⟧; φύσις (for parallel in π., v. G2305.b:
**† ⟪θειότης⟫, -ητος, ἡ
(< θεῖος) [in LXX: Wi 18:9*;] ⟪divine nature⟫, ⟪divinity⟫: ⟦Romans 1:20|Ro 1:20⟧ (for ex. from π., v. MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN.: θεότης, deity, godhead, divine personality. θει. = divine nature and properties, a summary term for the attributes of deity, differing from θεότης as quality or attribute from essence.
